cards.title: Om
cards.text: The first sound: the whole of existence in a single syllable.

cards.title: A · U · M
cards.text: Om has three sounds: waking, dreaming, deep sleep. The silence after is the fourth.

cards.title: Mantra
cards.text: From man, mind, and tra, tool: a mantra is a tool of the mind.

cards.title: Kirtan
cards.text: Call and response: one voice calls a name of the divine, everyone answers.

cards.title: Bhajan
cards.text: A devotional song, simple enough that everyone can join in.

cards.title: Om Namah Shivaya
cards.text: I bow to the inner Self, the stillness that was always here.

cards.title: Lokah Samastah Sukhino Bhavantu
cards.text: May all beings everywhere be happy and free.

cards.title: Om Mani Padme Hum
cards.text: The jewel in the lotus: compassion rising from the mud into the light.

cards.title: Hare Krishna
cards.text: Hare calls the divine energy, Krishna the one who draws every heart.

cards.title: Om Shanti Shanti Shanti
cards.text: Peace three times: in the body, in the mind, in the world around us.

cards.title: Gayatri
cards.text: A morning prayer: may the light of the sun awaken our understanding.

cards.title: Jai
cards.text: Victory! In kirtan it is a shout of joy: let the light win.

cards.title: Santoshi
cards.text: Santosha means contentment: being at peace with what is, right now.

cards.title: Japa mala
cards.text: A string of 108 beads: one mantra for each bead, round and round.

cards.title: Why 108
cards.text: 108 is sacred in many traditions, and it fits the beads of the mala.

cards.title: Sat Nam
cards.text: Truth is my name: a greeting to the truth in everyone.

cards.title: Shruti
cards.text: Shruti means what is heard. The drone of a shruti box is the ground of the song.

cards.title: The harmonium
cards.text: A small reed organ that keeps the key while the voices travel.

cards.title: The mridangam
cards.text: A two-headed drum of South India: the heartbeat under the chant.

cards.title: Navaratri
cards.text: Nine nights of the Goddess, nine nights of singing and dancing in the autumn.

cards.title: Garba
cards.text: A circle dance of Navaratri, turning around a light.

cards.title: Diwali
cards.text: The festival of lights: a small flame is stronger than a dark room.

cards.title: Santoshi Kirtan Band
cards.text: Seven of us from Zagreb: voices, guitars, djembe, mridangam, harmonium, bells.

cards.title: Come and sing
cards.text: Kirtan night: Saturday 21 November 2026, 19:00, Czech National House, Zagreb.

cards.title: Entry free
cards.text: Entry is free, donations are welcome. Come, sit, sing along.

cards.title: Earth · A
cards.text: The vowel A, low in the belly and the pelvis: the element of Earth.

cards.title: Water · U
cards.text: The vowel U, in the lower belly: the element of Water, flowing.

cards.title: Fire · I
cards.text: The vowel I, at the solar plexus: the element of Fire.

cards.title: Air · O
cards.text: The vowel O, in the chest, at the heart: the element of Air.

cards.title: Ether · A-U-I-O
cards.text: All the vowels together, in the throat: the element of Ether, space.

cards.title: Toning
cards.text: Toning is not singing: hold one vowel and let it vibrate in the body.
